evals.name: user-create-form
evals.prompt: I'm building a 'Create user' page in an IGRP app (templates/demo-v1 style). I need a form with: full name, email, role (admin / editor / viewer), active toggle, and a phone number. Validate with Zod. Show me the React component.
evals.expected_output: A 'use client' file using IGRPForm + a Zod schema + a formRef, with IGRPInputText / IGRPInputPhone (schema accepts string|undefined) / IGRPSelect or IGRPRadioGroup (with explicit label and placeholder) / IGRPSwitch bound by `name`. Submit is IGRPButton type='submit', with loading taken from useIGRPFormContext().isSubmitting. No raw <form>, no react-hook-form imports, no primitive <Input>.

evals.name: users-data-table
evals.prompt: Give me an IGRP data table component listing users with columns: name, email, status badge (active/blocked), created date, and row actions (Edit / Delete). The data comes from a prop.
evals.expected_output: Uses IGRPDataTable with stable columns (createIGRPColumnHelper<User>() or ColumnDef literals) at module scope or in useMemo. Status cell uses IGRPDataTableCellBadge with color success/destructive; the date uses IGRPDataTableCellDate. Row actions are passed through the `actions` prop: a 'link' action (Edit) and an 'alert' action with onConfirm (Delete). No actions rendered inside a cell; no imports from @tanstack/react-table. 'use client'.

evals.name: kpi-dashboard-card
evals.prompt: I want a dashboard widget: a card with title 'Receita mensal', a small subtitle, and a bar chart inside showing monthly revenue for 6 months. Pick the right components and colors.
evals.expected_output: Uses IGRPCard + IGRPCardHeader/IGRPCardTitle/IGRPCardDescription/IGRPCardContent as separate imports (no IGRPCard.Header) wrapping IGRPVerticalBarChart with categoryKey and bars=[{ dataKey, name }]. Colour is either omitted (palette by position) or set from IGRP_CHART_COLORS; no hex colours. valueFormatter, if present, is a function with an explicit Intl locale. 'use client'.
